question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**much**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is **'Yoga: Meditation and Breathing'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**much**'.
 
• The phrase '**much more**' means 'something is more valuable or useful to somebody than someone thinks (किसी के विचार से कुछ अधिक मूल्यवान या उपयोगी है)'.
 
 
• *Example: Softer fabrics are **much more** becoming than stiffer ones.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *If you thought that yoga was all about bending and twisting your body in odd shapes, it’s time to rethink. Yoga is **much** more. In very simple words, giving care (2) ______ your body, mind and breath is yoga. Derived (3) ______ the Sankrit word ‘yuj’ which means ‘to unite or integrate’, yoga is (4) ______ 5,000-year-old Indian body of knowledge. Yoga is all about harmonising the body (5) ______ the mind and breath through means of various breathing exercises, yoga poses (asanas) and meditation.*

43:T8f2,

The correct answer is 'to'
